name: English

phone.done: That was only a practice call. Nothing was real, and you are safe.

red_flags.scan_qr: Asks you to scan a QR
red_flags.secrecy: Tells you to keep it secret

lessons.scare: Scaring you on a sudden call is a scammer's first move. Stay calm and hang up.
lessons.otp: An OTP is only for you. Nobody genuine ever asks for it on a call.
lessons.rush: When someone rushes you, that is the moment to stop. A real company gives you time to think.
lessons.link: Never open a link because a caller sent it. It can steal your details.
lessons.app: Never install an app on a caller's word. It can hand them control of your phone.
lessons.pin: A UPI PIN only ever sends money. You never need it to receive money.
lessons.parcel: If you are not expecting a parcel, be suspicious of the call. Ask your family first.
lessons.refund: If someone says they sent money by mistake, check your own bank app. Usually no money ever came.
lessons.qr: Scanning a QR code sends money, it never brings money in.
lessons.fee: A real job or a real loan never asks you to pay first.
lessons.prize: You cannot win a prize you never entered. It is a trap.
lessons.card: Never tell anyone your card number, expiry date or CVV.
lessons.invest: Guaranteed huge returns are always a lie. Ask your family before you invest.
lessons.relative: If a call says a relative is in trouble, hang up and call that relative yourself, and ask for your secret family word.

confused: There is nothing to understand, just follow what I say.
Don't worry, I will make it simple.
asks_what: You don't have to do anything, just do as I say.
wants_time: There is no time, this has to happen now.
repeat: Listen, let me say that again.

openers: Hello, this is an important call.

comply: give me a minute let me read

templates.reveal_intro: Please stop. This was a Teeka practice call. Nothing here was real, and you are safe.
templates.reveal_outro: That is all right. Anyone can slip, and that is exactly why we practise. Next time, just hang up and tell your family.
templates.praise: Well done! This was a Teeka practice call, and you handled it perfectly. Saying no is the best thing you can do.
templates.wrap: This was a Teeka practice call. You did not share anything, and that is good. Remember, if you are unsure, hang up and ask your family.
templates.code_word: One more thing: agree on a secret family word. If someone with a familiar voice ever asks you for money or a code, ask for that word first.
templates.comfort: Please don't worry, everything is fine. This was a Teeka practice call and it has stopped now. Nothing was real. Please take a rest.

sms: You will get an SMS on your phone, look there.

I am sending it on WhatsApp, please check there.

Open your UPI app, the alert comes there.

You just install {app}, I will do the rest.
none: You do not need any new app, just stay on the line.
No app is needed, it all happens on this call.

paid: It is just {amount} rupees, nothing more.
otp_only: Not one rupee, I only need the code.
There is no money involved, just tell me the code.
receive: You pay nothing, the money comes to you.
Just scan it and the money reaches you.

upi: Open your UPI app and enter your PIN.
Through UPI, you only enter the PIN.
link: The payment happens in the link you receive.
Open the link, the pay button is right there.

Send it now to the account I am sending you.

As soon as you scan the QR it is done.
none: There is no payment, just say the code.
You send no money, just tell me the code you got.

today: It has to be done today.
